item.consent: `memo search all --harder` sends the question and its first 30 hits (each one's title, date and up to 400 characters of its text) to anthropic (api.anthropic.com), model claude-haiku-5-5, which puts the hits that answer it first. Only a search with --harder sends anything; one costs about $0.0004 with claude-haiku-5-5 and adds 1 to 2 seconds. `memo models search-consents revoke` turns it off.
